card: Removes trailing newlines from `WalletLogPrintf` calls across wallet code using a scripted diff, and adds a compile-time enforcement parameter to ConstevalFormatString so WalletLogPrintf strictly rejects trailing newlines. The author describes this as an ongoing style cleanup that eliminates manual churn in unrelated PRs and assists log-escaping consistency. No dependencies are noted.
changed_since_previous: Narrowed the scope from stripping newlines across the entire codebase (72 files) to specifically targeting `WalletLogPrintf` in wallet files, and added a compile-time check in `ConstevalFormatString` to disallow trailing newlines on `WalletLogPrintf` going forward.
evidence: Author notes: 'It is tedious and possibly distracting to do it manually when touching the line for other reasons. The topic recently came up again when discussing log injection (https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35833#issuecomment-5113804332)'.
problem: Trailing newlines in log format strings are inconsistent, redundant when underlying logging utilities handle line breaks, and distracting to clean up manually when modifying log calls. Without compile-time enforcement, trailing newlines are easily reintroduced.

risk.why: Mistakes would cause compile-time format string check errors or formatting defects in wallet log output without affecting runtime wallet safety or consensus.

scope_notes: Contains a scripted-diff commit using `sed` to strip trailing newlines from `WalletLogPrintf` calls, followed by template changes in `util::ConstevalFormatString` to enforce the restriction at compile time.
summary: Removes trailing newlines from one-line `WalletLogPrintf` messages via a scripted-diff and adds a compile-time check in `ConstevalFormatString` to reject trailing newlines, enforced on `WalletLogPrintf`. It also moves the `LogEscapeMessage` unit test into `logging_tests`.
